reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Quasi-trustee incorporation for educational and cultural institutions
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: § 352.020 historical, natural-science, museum, library, or art associations in a city/town may incorporate as public quasi-trustees under a perpetual non-amendable charter contract.

headings.title: Prohibition on contracting debt and mortgage or alienation restrictions
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: prohibits contracting debts (void ipso facto) and bars mortgaging, deeding in trust, or selling property except by exchange of equal value or for reinvestment.

headings.title: Property vesting in municipal trust upon corporate dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3: upon dissolution, property vests in the local city or town in trust for the same public purposes.

headings.title: Public membership open under reasonable bylaw regulations
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 4: membership must be open to the public under reasonable bylaw rules and regulations.

headings.title: Mandatory perpetual endowment fund and permitted investment classes
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 5: requires perpetual intact endowment fund accumulated to at least $200,000, investable in government bonds or Missouri improved real-estate mortgages (barring private/railroad stock or personal security) with principal unencroachable.

headings.title: Public access to collections and prohibition on loaning exhibits
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 6: museum, gallery, and cabinets open to Missouri public under reasonable rules; contents may not be loaned or taken out for exhibition or other purpose.

headings.title: Existing corporate charter amendment to adopt trust provisions
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 7: existing qualifying corporations whose charter harmonizes with § 352.040 may adopt it by charter amendment under § 352.070.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 352.040 (bid 18956), all seven subsections, and history notes (RSMo 1939 § 5447; prior revisions 1909–1929). Retained all seven titles.

headings.title: Petition submission to circuit court for incorporation
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: president, secretary, and treasurer (or other chief officers) submit articles of agreement and petition for pro forma decree to local circuit court.

headings.title: Circuit court order, friend of court, and recording
headings.reviewNote: Refined title to include friend-of-court review. Verified sub 2: 3-day file period, friend-of-court inquiry if judge doubts lawfulness/public usefulness, order granting/dismissing, county recording, and secretary of state filing.

headings.title: Secretary of state certified copy as corporate charter
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3: secretary of state issues certified copy of filed articles and certificates as corporate charter, received in all courts as legal evidence of incorporation.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 352.060 (bid 18958), all three subsections, and history notes (RSMo 1939 § 5437; prior revisions 1909–1929). Refined sub 2 title to reflect the 3-day waiting period, friend-of-court review, recording, and secretary of state filing.

headings.title: Corporate location change petition and court decree
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: chapter 352 corporations may relocate to another Missouri county/city by filing certified articles and chief-officers' petition in the destination circuit court under § 352.020 procedures.

headings.title: Perpetual succession and preservation of prior obligations
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: relocation preserves perpetual succession to all rights, franchises, and properties, and continues liability for all prior obligations.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 352.080 (bid 18960), both subsections, and source note (RSMo 1939 § 5441). Retained both titles.

headings.title: Bylaws for governance, property management, and member admission
headings.reviewNote: Corrected note (removed unstated voting rights). Verified sub 1: requires bylaws for government, support, property management, and (unless in charter) admission and qualifications of new members.

headings.title: Removal of officers for cause and expulsion of members
headings.reviewNote: Corrected note (removed unstated hearing clause). Verified sub 2: bylaws may provide for removing officers for cause and expelling members guilty of offenses affecting corporate interests/good government or indictable by law, consistent with charter and state law.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 352.110 (bid 18963), both subsections, and history notes (RSMo 1939 § 5446; prior revisions 1909–1929). Corrected reviewNotes to remove unstated voting-rights and hearing-procedure claims; retained both titles.

headings.title: Member majority authorization for merger or consolidation agreement
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: requires affirmative vote of a majority of voting members of each party corporation before entering a merger/consolidation agreement, subject to circuit court approval.

headings.title: Circuit court petition and approval decree
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: submission of agreement and petition to circuit court where either corporation is located; court enters approval order if member consent obtained and purposes lawful.

headings.title: Three-day petition filing period and friend of the court appointment
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3: 3-day waiting period on file; judge 'may' appoint a competent person as friend of the court to examine and present testimony if legality is doubted.

headings.title: Recording with recorder of deeds and secretary of state charter issuance
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 4: record agreement and court order with county recorder(s) of deeds, file with secretary of state, who issues certified copy as charter of consolidated corporation.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 352.150 (bid 18967), all four subsections, and history notes (RSMo 1939 § 5458; prior revision 1929 § 5021). Retained all four titles.

headings.title: Unimpaired debtor and creditor relations succession upon merger
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: debtor and creditor rights, obligations, and relations of merged/consolidated corporations remain unimpaired and pass to the consolidated corporation.

headings.title: Continuation of pending actions and substitution of parties
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: pending judicial proceedings do not abate upon merger/consolidation and may proceed to judgment or substitute the consolidated corporation.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 352.170 (bid 18969), both subsections, and history notes (RSMo 1939 § 5460; prior revision 1929 § 5023). Retained both titles.

headings.title: Order to show cause upon filing dissolution petition
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: court (in term time) or clerk (in vacation) issues show-cause order requiring interested persons to show cause against dissolution by a named day/term.

headings.title: Voluntary appearance and resident summons procedure
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: allows voluntary appearance; county-resident members, creditors, and executory-contract holders who do not appear are served by summons returnable 21 to 30 days after filing.

headings.title: Publication notice for nonresidents and proof of service
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3: newspaper publication notice (5 consecutive daily or 3 weekly insertions) for all other members, creditors, and contract holders; proof of service and publication required before any order.

headings.title: Court power to continue application and issue new process
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 4: court may continue the application for service on all interested parties and issue new writs if necessary.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 352.200 (bid 18972), all four subsections, and source note (RSMo 1939 § 5463). Retained all four titles.

headings.title: Dissolution decree and vesting of property in receiver
headings.reviewNote: Refined title to include property vesting. Verified sub 1: if dissolution does not prejudice public welfare, members, or creditors, court 'may' decree dissolution and vest property in court-appointed receiver(s).

headings.title: Receiver security, title succession, and asset administration
headings.reviewNote: Corrected title/note (removed unstated trustee/liquidating-director reference). Verified sub 2: upon court-approved security, receiver(s) succeed to title in trust for creditors and entitled persons and administer assets under court orders.

headings.title: Surplus distribution and charitable property preservation
headings.reviewNote: Refined title. Verified sub 3: post-debt surplus distributed equally to members at dissolution (unless court orders otherwise for good cause), provided religious, literary, or charitable property is preserved from diversion.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 352.210 (bid 18973), all three subsections, and source note (RSMo 1939 § 5464). Revised sub 2 title/note (text specifies court-appointed receivers, not trustees or liquidating directors) and tightened sub 3 title.

headings.title: Quo warranto proceedings against corporation or officers for unlawful acts
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: circuit court inquires via quo warranto by AG or circuit attorney at any person's relation into unlawful acts, misuser, or nonuser of franchise.

headings.title: Judgment of forfeiture, dissolution, and property vesting in court receiver
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: upon forfeiture/dissolution judgment, court may vest property in bonded receiver(s) who hold title in trust for creditors and administer assets under court order.

headings.title: Surplus distribution and charitable or section 352.040 trusts
headings.reviewNote: Revised title to include charitable-trust and § 352.040 proviso. Verified sub 3: post-debt surplus distributed equally to members unless court orders otherwise, except charitable-trust property vests in trustees and § 352.040 property follows § 352.040 dissolution rules.

headings.title: Prosecutor duty to investigate complaints and institute quo warranto
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 4: AG or circuit/prosecuting attorney must diligently investigate sworn credible-person complaints of willful misuse or 2-year nonuse and institute quo warranto upon reasonable cause.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 352.240 (bid 18976), all four subsections, and history notes (RSMo 1939 § 5449; note printed prior revision repeats '1919 § 3444'). Revised sub 3 title to include charitable-trust and § 352.040 preservation proviso.

headings.title: Prohibited self-dealing, excess holdings, investments, and expenditures
headings.reviewNote: Refined title to match statutory terms. Verified sub 1(1)-(4): bars IRC § 509(a) private foundations from self-dealing (§ 4941), excess business holdings (§ 4943), jeopardizing investments (§ 4944), and taxable expenditures (§ 4945).

headings.title: Mandatory annual income distributions to avoid tax liability
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: private foundations (§ 509) must distribute amounts each taxable year sufficient to avoid IRC § 4942(a) tax.

headings.title: Court exception for conflicting governing instruments
headings.reviewNote: Corrected title/note (applies to subs 1 and 2; corporation shielded from prior sub 2 payment liability). Verified sub 3: inapplicability where court determines compliance conflicts with unchangeable governing instruments.

headings.title: Preservation of court powers and attorney general authority
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 4: does not impair rights and powers of Missouri courts or attorney general with respect to any corporation.

headings.title: Incorporation of federal Internal Revenue Code provisions as of June 14, 1971
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 5: all IRC references are to federal law as of June 14, 1971.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 352.245 (bid 18977), all five subsections with subdivisions (1)-(4), and source/effective-date notes (L. 1971 S.B. 48, effective 6-14-71). Refined sub 1 title (jeopardizing investments and taxable expenditures) and sub 3 title/note (applies to both subs 1 and 2 and shields the corporation, not directors).

headings.title: Definitions of abuse, child, minister, neglect, and religious organization
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1(1)-(6): defines 'abuse', 'child', 'minister', 'neglect', 'religious organization', and 'report' for §§ 210.109–210.183 reporting.

headings.title: Mandatory child abuse reporting duty and privileged communication exception
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: ministers and sub 3 designated agents with reasonable cause must immediately report abuse/neglect under §§ 210.109–210.183; exempts ministers from reporting professional privileged communications.

headings.title: Religious organization designated reporting agents and internal notification
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3 (source prints '210.109 to 213.183' once alongside '210.109 to 210.183'): religious organizations may designate reporting agents; internal notification required if minister/official/staff with probable cause does not personally report; does not preclude reporting by anyone else.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 352.400 (bid 18978), all three subsections with subdivisions (1)-(6), and history notes (L. 2002, A.L. 2003). Noted source citation typo '210.109 to 213.183' in sub 3; retained all three titles.

headings.title: Department notification requirements for charitable gift annuity issuers
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1(1)-(3): qualified organizations issuing qualified charitable gift annuities must notify DCI in writing by the later of 90 days after Aug. 28, 2001 or first agreement date, signed by officer/director with qualification certifications.

headings.title: Submission of additional information for penalty determinations
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: organization must submit additional information if necessary to determine applicable penalties under § 352.520.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 352.505 (bid 18980), both subsections with subdivisions, and history notes (L. 1996 S.B. 768 § 2, A.L. 2001 H.B. 664). Retained both titles.
